elements.text:
ABOVE PLAN, BELOW AMBITION
Mexico operates in a stable macroeconomic environment, supported by solid fundamentals, a large and young workforce, and deep North American integration. While near‑term growth is expected to remain moderate, the environment remains constructive for disciplined, profitable banking growth
SBM is at a pivotal moment. The franchise is delivering on the 2026 plan, anchored in a strong Risk and Control operation. At the same time, SBM is yet to reach its full potential, and acceleration in client acquisition and share-of-wallet growth 
While Q1 FY26 results exceed plan across key metrics reflecting early traction, structural factors such as deposit and loan mix, client experience, and scale in priority segments persist as long-term challenges
Reaching the 2030 ambition will require more than momentum. It will depend on disciplined execution and targeted strategic choices to strengthen primacy, transactional volume and sustainable scale, with a sharper focus on distribution capabilities to strengthen our position
WHERE WE ARE WINNING
Robust governance and disciplined execution across strategic priorities, anchored by a strong, talented team
PCLs are stabilizing and exhibiting a positive trend; however, challenges persist with legacy portfolios
Wealth Management sustains momentum with double‑digit growth
Strong Corporate Banking franchise 
Commercial Banking on the right path to reach profitability
WHAT ARE OUR CHALLENGES
A deposit mix skewed toward higher cost of funds relative to peers
Excess concentration in secured lending leading to lower return in Retail Banking
Insufficient digital capabilities have driven a heavy reliance on branch execution while frontline sales productivity remains constrained
Under‑penetration of transactional banking solutions across segments challenging primacy
Accelerate penetration rates in GBM clients with focus on Cash Management and FX
Limited client acquisition and an uncompetitive payroll proposition have capped our scaling potential
